hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'DCG="${HOME}/.local/share/mise/shims/dcg"; [ -x "$DCG" ] || DCG="/opt/mise/shims/dcg"; [ -x "$DCG" ] || DCG="$(command -v dcg 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "$DCG" ] && "$DCG" --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$DCG" --agent claude-code; fi; in=$(cat); case "$in" in *\"command\":\"mise\ install\"*|*\"command\":\"mise\ install\ *|*\"command\":\ \"mise\ install\"*|*\"command\":\ \"mise\ install\ *|*\"command\":\"mise\ doctor\"*|*\"command\":\"mise\ doctor\ *|*\"command\":\ \"mise\ doctor\"*|*\"command\":\ \"mise\ doctor\ *) case "$in" in *[\;\&\|\`\<\>]*|*\$\(*|*\\n*|*\\r*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac;; esac; echo "dcg unavailable: guard fails closed; only mise install/doctor may run (or fix it from a human terminal)" >&2; exit 2'
